Scopus also lists 1,546 preprints in a separate preprint index, which offers no export; they are not among the records. The Scopus search was run by an AI session in an author's signed-in browser; OpenAlex and arXiv were queried through their public APIs, OpenAlex in 73 pages and arXiv in 4 pages, and every request URL is kept in the log. The exact queries were:
\par\medskip\noindent\textbf{Scopus (advanced search)}
\begin{lstlisting}
( TITLE-ABS ( smote OR oversampling OR "over-sampling" OR "synthetic minority" OR "adaptive synthetic" OR "synthetic samples" OR "synthetic instances" ) OR AUTHKEY ( smote OR oversampling OR "over-sampling" OR "synthetic minority" OR "adaptive synthetic" OR "synthetic samples" OR "synthetic instances" ) ) AND ( TITLE-ABS ( imbalanced OR imbalance OR "minority class" OR "minority classes" ) OR AUTHKEY ( imbalanced OR imbalance OR "minority class" OR "minority classes" ) ) AND PUBYEAR > 2001
\end{lstlisting}
\par\medskip\noindent\textbf{OpenAlex (filter of the works endpoint)}
\begin{lstlisting}
title_and_abstract.search:(SMOTE OR oversampling OR "over-sampling" OR "synthetic minority" OR "adaptive synthetic" OR "synthetic samples" OR "synthetic instances") AND (imbalanced OR imbalance OR "minority class" OR "minority classes"),publication_year:2002-2026,type:article|preprint|book-chapter|review
\end{lstlisting}
\par\medskip\noindent\textbf{arXiv (search query of the export API)}
\begin{lstlisting}
((ti:smote OR abs:smote OR ti:oversampling OR abs:oversampling OR ti:"over-sampling" OR abs:"over-sampling" OR ti:"synthetic minority" OR abs:"synthetic minority" OR ti:"adaptive synthetic" OR abs:"adaptive synthetic" OR ti:"synthetic samples" OR abs:"synthetic samples" OR ti:"synthetic instances" OR abs:"synthetic instances") AND (ti:imbalanced OR abs:imbalanced OR ti:imbalance OR abs:imbalance OR ti:"minority class" OR abs:"minority class" OR ti:"minority classes" OR abs:"minority classes")) AND submittedDate:[200201010000 TO 202611112359]
\end{lstlisting}
